endpoints.endpointName: Rum River South County Park access
endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: mn_dnr_rum_south_county_public_access_anchor WAS00289: Current Minnesota DNR public-water-access record WAS00289 identifies an Anoka County-managed trailer launch at river mile 1.9 on river right, with two ramps, GPS coordinate collection, and access at the Anoka County Fairgrounds. DNR Rum River Map 3 marks Rum River South County Park at river mile 1.9 with trailer and carry-in access; Anoka County confirms boat and canoe/kayak launches at the park. Treat the published site point as the access anchor, not a surveyed water-entry toe.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (mn_dnr_rum_south_county_public_access_anchor WAS00289) on Rum River; treat the agency parking/carry anchor as on/near-water evidence, but confirm the exact water entry and landing before launch.

endpoints.endpointName: Germanium carry-in access at Brookview Park
endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: mn_dnr_rum_germanium_public_access_anchor WAS02989: Current Minnesota DNR public-water-access record WAS02989 names 'Rum River, Geranium Public Water Access Site', assigns the City of Ramsey as administrator, identifies a gravel carry-in and five car spaces, and places it at river mile 9.0 on river right. DNR Rum River Map 3 identifies the Germanium carry-in at the same river mile in Brookview City Park, and the City of Ramsey identifies Brookview Park at 17200 Germanium Street NW. The GIS point was created by heads-up digitizing; use it as the public access-area anchor, not as a surveyed water-entry toe.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (mn_dnr_rum_germanium_public_access_anchor WAS02989) on Rum River; treat the agency parking/carry anchor as on/near-water evidence, but confirm the exact water entry and landing before launch.
